description: VERUS_SQL_COVERAGE task N: integer and numeric division (signs, NULL, 22012, MIN / -1 22003, value-dependent result scale, half-away-from-zero ties) and AVG (int4/int8/numeric to numeric, NULL/empty, magnitude-dependent scale, no overflow of the int4 sum, AVG of dynamic-scale values), plus one dynamic-scale GROUP BY key. Rows are selected per case by g; y is a numeric(10,0) copy of a where numeric division of integral values is shown.

ddl.sql: CREATE TABLE t (id integer NOT NULL, g integer NOT NULL, a integer, b integer, c bigint, x numeric(17,4), y numeric(10,0));

cases.name: int_div_signs
cases.sql: SELECT id, a / b AS q4, c / b AS q8 FROM t WHERE g = 1
cases.note: int4 / int4 is int4 and int8 / int4 is int8, truncated toward zero: 7/2 = 3, -7/2 = -3, 7/-2 = -3, -7/-2 = 3.

cases.name: int_div_null_by_zero
cases.sql: SELECT a / b AS q4, c / b AS q8 FROM t WHERE g = 2
cases.note: Division is strict: NULL / 0 is NULL, not 22012.

cases.name: int_div_by_zero
cases.sql: SELECT a / b AS q FROM t WHERE g = 3

cases.name: int4_min_div_minus_one
cases.sql: SELECT a / b AS q FROM t WHERE g = 4

cases.name: int8_min_div_minus_one
cases.sql: SELECT c / b AS q FROM t WHERE g = 5
cases.note: int8 -9223372036854775808 / -1 (int4 divisor cast to int8) is 22003 (bigint out of range).

cases.name: num_div_scale_and_rounding
cases.sql: SELECT id, y / b AS qa, x / b AS qx FROM t WHERE g IN (1, 6, 10, 12)
cases.note: select_div_scale: 7/2 at scale 16, 2.25/-2 at 20 (leading digit 2 <= 2), 1/10000 at 24, 3/2 at 16 vs 15000/10000 at 20, 3000000000000.0001/3 at 8; 2/3 and -2/3 round to ...67; 3000000000000.0001/2 and -3000000000000.0001/2 are exact ties at scale 4 and round away from zero.

cases.name: num_div_by_zero
cases.sql: SELECT x / b AS q FROM t WHERE g = 3

cases.name: avg_types_and_groups
cases.sql: SELECT g, AVG(a) AS avg_a, AVG(c) AS avg_c, AVG(x) AS avg_x, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t WHERE g IN (1, 7, 8, 9) GROUP BY g
cases.note: AVG of int4/int8/numeric is numeric; NULLs ignored; an all-NULL group is NULL; a zero average of ints has scale 20; 2 x 2147483647 averages without overflow (scale 8); 2 x (2^63 - 1) exactly (scale 0); {10000, 20000} at scale 12; numeric {7, -7, NULL, 2.25} (scale 4) is 0.75 at scale 20.

cases.name: avg_empty
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_a, AVG(x) AS avg_x, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t WHERE g = 100
cases.note: AVG over no rows is NULL.

cases.name: avg_of_dynamic_scale
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(y / b) AS m FROM t WHERE g = 6
cases.note: AVG sums 1.5000000000000000 (scale 16) and 1.50000000000000000000 (scale 20) exactly at scale 20, then divides by 2.

cases.name: group_by_dynamic_scale_key
cases.sql: SELECT y / b AS q, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t WHERE g = 6 GROUP BY y / b
cases.note: 3/2 (scale 16) and 15000/10000 (scale 20) are one group by SQL value equality; the displayed key scale is the representative's (PostgreSQL: plan-dependent; GenDB: first occurrence, R1/D2), so q is compared by value only.
